{{Top}}
'''Desalination''', or '''desalinization''', was a method used to make [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Water/Legends|water]] suitable for drinking or irrigation. Large desalinization tanks and other devices were utilized in the process.

[[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]] was a planet where desalination was used.
